title: RWS MWTL — suspended matter, near-bed samples
description: Rijkswaterstaat MWTL water-quality monitoring, 1972–2021: suspended matter (zwevende stof, dry weight after filtration) in water samples at ~110 Wadden Sea and coastal stations, monthly to fortnightly. Split from MWTL_Turbidity.csv with tools/split_csv.py --by referentievlak; only quality code 0 (normal value) is kept. These are the samples referenced to the bed (BODM), taken 1–4 m above it.
